tools.name: get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Look up one product by slug or Steam ID. Returns null when the product is not found or not available in the region. The record also lists the game's other editions and its DLC, each capped at 10 with a count of the true total; set include_related to false to omit them. See https://www.fanatical.com/for-ai/tools or read the "docs" resource.

slug.description: Product slug. Get from a product URL or a search_products result.

steam_id.description: Steam application ID. Use when the Steam ID is known. Editions of one game share a Steam ID, so this returns the base edition. Use slug to get a specific edition.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Default US. Sets availability filtering and local pricing in the currency Fanatical transacts in for that region. Region should always be set to the user's location if known for most accurate availability and pricing.

include_related.description: When true, the record carries editions and dlc arrays for the game, each capped at 10, with editions_count and dlc_count giving the true totals. Default true. Set false to omit them and make the response smaller - it saves one indexed query and up to a few thousand tokens on games with many DLC.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region code this response was resolved for.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code used for every monetary field in this response.

product_id.description: Internal product identifier. Regional and edition variants have distinct product_ids. Stable while a listing is live; a re-listed product may get a new product_id.

slug.description: URL slug. Shared across regional variants of the same product.

name.description: Display name. Plain text - no markup, no HTML entities.

short_description.description: Plain-text summary, up to ~240 characters. No markup, no HTML entities. Line breaks are newline characters. Falls back to a truncated full description when no short description is set.

url.description: Canonical English product URL with tracking parameters. Use exactly as returned - do not strip the query string.

cart_url.description: Add-to-cart URL for this product. It opens the product page with the product already in the basket, and with the voucher applied when the product has a coupon. Use it as the target of an "Add to cart" action in your answer. Null for a bundle where the customer must select a tier or select which items they want, because one URL cannot give a definite basket - link to url instead. Use exactly as returned - do not strip the query string.

image.description: Primary cover image URL at 1280x720 landscape. This is the canonical Fanatical cover art for the product. Prefer it over running a separate image search on the product name, which often picks up store-listing screenshots from competitor retailers.

vertical_image.description: Portrait cover image URL at 600x900. Null when not available. Same guidance as image - this is the canonical portrait cover, prefer it over image search.

type.description: Fine-grained product type. Note: search_products.type accepts only "game", "dlc", or "bundle" as input filters; the input "bundle" matches the output values "bundle", "game-bundle" and "mystery-bundle" (game-focused bundles only in v1). Book, software, and audio bundles are in the response but not filterable in v1.

in_stock.description: Purchasable at the last ingest cycle. Data may be up to ten minutes stale.

drm.description: Primary DRM platform (e.g. "steam", "drm free", "gog", "epicgames"). Null when no DRM applies.

price.description: Current price after any non-coupon discount, in the region's currency.

full_price.description: Original price before any discount, in the region's currency. Equal to price when not on sale. For pick-and-mix bundles, this is the entry-tier price, not a pre-discount reference - the two are equal by construction. Read discount_percent for the saving against the constituent items' RRP.

discount_percent.description: Percent off list price, 0-100. Zero when not on sale. For pick-and-mix bundles this represents the saving versus RRP of the constituent items.

sale_slug.description: Slug of the curated sale event this product is in, or null when not in a curated sale. A product with sale_slug=null can still be discounted - sale_slug indicates curated sale membership, not the presence of a discount.

sale_name.description: Human-readable sale event name, or null when sale_slug is null.

promo_label.description: Highest-priority promotional label. Priority: star-deal > best-ever > highlighted-deal > flash-sale. Only the top applicable label is shown. Absent when no label applies.

steam_id.description: Steam identifier, usually the application identifier, or null when not on Steam. Not unique: a DLC or add-on kit carries the identifier of its base game. A lookup by steam_id returns the base edition. Look up a specific edition by slug.

steam_deck_support.description: Valve's Steam Deck compatibility rating, or null when Valve has not rated the product.

steam_machine_support.description: Valve's Steam Machine compatibility rating, same semantics as steam_deck_support.

tags.description: Category tags: genres, themes, playstyles. Display names for humans. To filter by these, pass the slug form (tags_slugs) to search_products.tag. On a bundle-type product, this is the union of every pool item's tags, not a description of the bundle itself, and can run to 100+ entries.

franchises.description: Franchises this product belongs to (display names).

tags_slugs.description: Slug form of tags. Pass to search_products.tag to filter more products with the same tags.

developers_slugs.description: Slug form of developers. Pass to search_products.developer.

publishers_slugs.description: Slug form of publishers. Pass to search_products.publisher.

franchises_slugs.description: Slug form of franchises. Pass to search_products.franchise.

operating_systems.description: Supported operating systems. Multiple entries when the product supports several.

vr_support.description: VR headset and feature flags. Empty array when the product has no VR support.

metacritic_score.description: Metacritic score. Number when available; some source records provide it as a string. Null when no score.

steam_review_score.description: Steam review score on a 1 to 9 scale, not a percentage: 1 is "Overwhelmingly Negative", 5 "Mixed", 8 "Very Positive", 9 "Overwhelmingly Positive". 0 means either that Steam has too few reviews to rate the product, or that this listing has no review data of its own. Usually a string; some source records provide it as a number. Null when the product has no Steam review data.

code.description: Coupon code the user enters at checkout.

percent.description: Additional discount percent applied by the coupon, on top of the base discount.

coupon_price.description: Final price after applying the coupon, in the region's currency.

coupon_saving.description: Amount saved by applying the coupon versus the base price, in the region's currency.

valid_until.description: Coupon expiry as Unix seconds, or null when the coupon has no expiry.

coupon_url.description: Apply-coupon URL for this product. It opens the product page and applies the voucher, but it does not put the product in the basket. anyOf.description: Active voucher for this product. Null unless a coupon is currently applicable. The coupon is not applied to price or discount_percent - read coupon_price for the real final price. "price_asc", "price_desc", and "release_date" each exclude products with no value in that field, regardless of include_presale or include_preorder - use a different sort, or no sort, if those rows must appear. Without sort, results rank by relevance when query is set and by best-seller rank otherwise.

tools.name: search_products
tools.title: Search products
tools.description: Search the catalogue by structured filters, with optional free-text query and sort. Filter values come from list_facets and list_sales. Results use the region's currency. Use get_product or get_products to retrieve the full data for products. See https://www.fanatical.com/for-ai/tools or read the "docs" resource.

query.description: Free-text search over product name and short description. Name matches rank higher than description matches. Prefix-matched, so partial words work.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Default US. Sets availability filtering and local pricing in the currency Fanatical transacts in for that region. Region should always be set to the user's location if known for most accurate availability and pricing.

limit.description: Maximum products to return. Default 20, maximum 100.

tag.description: Category slug or array of slugs. Slugs must come from list_facets with facet=tags - any slug not currently in that list returns zero results with no error. When search_products returns zero results and you did not resolve the slugs first, call list_facets to validate. Multiple values are OR-ed.

publisher.description: Publisher slug or array of slugs. Slugs must come from list_facets with facet=publishers - any slug not currently in that list returns zero results with no error. When search_products returns zero results and you did not resolve the slugs first, call list_facets to validate. Multiple values are OR-ed..

franchise.description: Franchise slug or array of slugs. Slugs must come from list_facets with facet=franchises - any slug not currently in that list returns zero results with no error. When search_products returns zero results and you did not resolve the slugs first, call list_facets to validate. Multiple values are OR-ed..

developer.description: Developer slug or array of slugs. Slugs must come from list_facets with facet=developers - any slug not currently in that list returns zero results with no error. When search_products returns zero results and you did not resolve the slugs first, call list_facets to validate. Multiple values are OR-ed..

type.description: Product type. When unset, results include games, DLC and bundles together. Set type to "game" to find playable games only - recommended when the user is looking for a specific game or genre. "bundle" covers game bundles only; book, software, and audio bundles are not supported. A non-null bundle_price_messages on a result marks it as a multi-item pack regardless of the type value returned - check that field, not type, to detect packs.

sale_slug.description: Restrict to one sale. Slug must come from list_sales - a plausible-looking guess that is not in the list silently returns zero results.

steam_deck_support.description: Steam Deck compatibility rating. Exact match. Products without a rating are excluded.

steam_machine_support.description: Steam Machine compatibility rating. Exact match. Products without a rating are excluded.

min_steam_review_score.description: Minimum Steam review score. Steam grades reviews on a 1 to 9 scale, not a percentage: 5 is "Mixed", 6 "Mostly Positive", 7 "Positive", 8 "Very Positive", 9 "Overwhelmingly Positive". Use 6 for well-reviewed products. Products with no score are excluded, and so are products with a score of 0 - too few reviews to rate, or no review data for the listing.

min_discount.description: Minimum discount percent (0 to 100). Filters by percentage off list price, not absolute saving.

min_price.description: Minimum price in the region's currency. Excludes products with no price in that currency.

max_price.description: Maximum price in the region's currency. Excludes products with no price in that currency.

include_out_of_stock.description: When true, includes out-of-stock products. Default false.

include_presale.description: When true, includes presale products (no final price set). Default false. Implies include_out_of_stock.

include_preorder.description: When true, includes preorder products (release_date in the future). Default false. Implies include_out_of_stock.

sort.description: Sort order. "discount" sorts by percentage off, not absolute saving - a high-discount cheap item ranks above a low-discount expensive item. "valid_until_asc" surfaces sales that end soonest; compare the valid_until field (Unix seconds) against the current time to judge urgency. "steam_review_score" sorts by Steam review score, highest first, and excludes products with no score - the scale has only nine steps, so best-seller rank breaks the many ties inside each step. "price_asc", "price_desc", and "release_date" each exclude products with no value in that field, regardless of include_presale or include_preorder - use a different sort, or no sort, if those rows must appear. Without sort, results rank by relevance when query is set and by best-seller rank otherwise.

full_price.description: Original price before any discount, in the region's currency. Equal to price when not on sale. For pick-and-mix bundles, this is the entry-tier price, not a pre-discount reference - the two are equal by construction. Read discount_percent for the saving against the constituent items' RRP.

discount_percent.description: Percent off list price, 0-100. Zero when not on sale. For pick-and-mix bundles this represents the saving versus RRP of the constituent items.

sale_slug.description: Slug of the curated sale event this product is in, or null when not in a curated sale. A product with sale_slug=null can still be discounted - sale_slug indicates curated sale membership, not the presence of a discount.

sale_name.description: Human-readable sale event name, or null when sale_slug is null.

promo_label.description: Highest-priority promotional label. Priority: star-deal > best-ever > highlighted-deal > flash-sale. Only the top applicable label is shown. Absent when no label applies.

valid_until.description: When the current price and availability expire, as Unix seconds. Null when open-ended. Includes sale end, coupon end, key stock expiry, or a scheduled price change. Compare to the current time to gauge urgency.

steam_deck_support.description: Valve's Steam Deck compatibility rating, or null when Valve has not rated the product.

steam_machine_support.description: Valve's Steam Machine compatibility rating, same semantics as steam_deck_support.

in_stock.description: Purchasable at the last ingest cycle. Data may be up to ten minutes stale.

drm.description: Primary DRM platform (e.g. "steam", "drm free", "gog", "epicgames"). Null when no DRM applies.

release_date.description: Release date as Unix seconds, or null when undated. May be in the future for preorders.

tags_slugs.description: Slug form of tags. Pass to search_products.tag to filter more products with the same tags.

publishers_slugs.description: Slug form of publishers. Pass to search_products.publisher.

franchises_slugs.description: Slug form of franchises. Pass to search_products.franchise.

developers_slugs.description: Slug form of developers. Pass to search_products.developer.

slug.description: Bundle URL slug. Use with get_product to fetch full bundle detail including tiers.

url.description: Bundle landing-page URL with tracking parameters.

image.description: Bundle cover image URL at 1280x720 landscape. This is the canonical Fanatical cover art for the product. Prefer it over running a separate image search on the product name, which often picks up store-listing screenshots from competitor retailers.

price.description: Current bundle price, in the region's currency. For variable-price bundles this is the entry-tier price.

full_price.description: Bundle full price before discount, in the region's currency. Equal to price when the bundle is not discounted.

bundle_type.description: Bundle pricing model. "standard": fixed price, fixed set. "tiered": fixed tier prices, each tier includes lower tiers. "pay-what-you-want": customer names their price above a floor, usually for charity. "build-your-own": customer picks N items from a pool; more items = lower per-item price.

bundle_product_count.description: Total items in the bundle (top tier for variable-price bundles).

minimum_product_count.description: Smallest tier size for tiered and build-your-own bundles.

variable_price.description: True for tiered, pay-what-you-want, and build-your-own bundles.

tiny.description: Minimal one-line price pitch. Example: "5 for £4.99".

short.description: Short summary of the bundle pricing. Example: "Get 5 games for £4.99".

value.description: Value-focused pitch. Example: "Save 80% with a 5-game pick-and-mix".

long.description: Full descriptive copy listing every tier. Example: "3 for £2.99, 5 for £4.99, or 10 for £8.99".

bundle_price_messages.description: Pre-rendered bundle marketing copy in five lengths, already folded to the region's currency. Use these instead of synthesising a bundle pitch - phrasing is tuned per bundle_type and per length. Null values mean the copy for this currency was not generated.

anyOf.description: Reference to a bundle this product is currently sold as part of. Present only when the product is in a live bundle. Use bundle_price_messages for a ready-to-quote pitch - an agent recommending this game can name-drop the bundle without synthesising the copy. Products can only be in one bundle at any one time, use get_product to find the full bundle contents.

tiny.description: Minimal one-line price pitch. Example: "5 for £4.99".

short.description: Short summary of the bundle pricing. Example: "Get 5 games for £4.99".

value.description: Value-focused pitch. Example: "Save 80% with a 5-game pick-and-mix".

long.description: Full descriptive copy listing every tier. Example: "3 for £2.99, 5 for £4.99, or 10 for £8.99".

bundle_price_messages.description: Pre-rendered pitch copy for this bundle, folded to the region's currency. Use verbatim.

metacritic_score.description: Metacritic score. Number when available; some source records provide it as a string. Null when no score.

steam_review_score.description: Steam review score on a 1 to 9 scale, not a percentage: 1 is "Overwhelmingly Negative", 5 "Mixed", 8 "Very Positive", 9 "Overwhelmingly Positive". 0 means either that Steam has too few reviews to rate the product, or that this listing has no review data of its own. Usually a string; some source records provide it as a number. Null when the product has no Steam review data.

steam_review_score_desc.description: Steam review label for steam_review_score, e.g. "Very Positive", "Overwhelmingly Positive". When the score is 0, the label gives the review count instead, e.g. "No user reviews" or "3 user reviews". Null when the product has no Steam review data.

operating_systems.description: Supported operating systems. Multiple entries when the product supports several.

vr_support.description: VR headset and feature flags. Empty array when the product has no VR support.

code.description: Coupon code the user enters at checkout.

percent.description: Additional discount percent applied by the coupon, on top of the base discount.

coupon_price.description: Final price after applying the coupon, in the region's currency.

coupon_url.description: Apply-coupon URL for this product. It opens the product page and applies the voucher, but it does not put the product in the basket. Use it as the target of an "Apply coupon" action in your answer. To do both steps with one link, use the cart_url of the product. Use exactly as returned - do not strip the query string.

anyOf.description: Active voucher for this product, trimmed for search results. Null unless a coupon is currently applicable. Note that price does not include the coupon: quote coupon_price as the real price for the user. get_product returns the full coupon, with its name, description, saving and expiry.

tools.name: list_sales
tools.title: List sales
tools.description: List active sales in a region. Each result gives the sale slug, product count, discount range, and end time. An empty array is valid — it means no sale is running. See https://www.fanatical.com/for-ai/tools or read the "docs" resource.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Default US. Sets availability filtering and local pricing in the currency Fanatical transacts in for that region. Region should always be set to the user's location if known for most accurate availability and pricing.
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region code this response was resolved for.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code - sales themselves have no prices, but this is what any subsequent search_products call for products in these sales would use.

sale_slug.description: Sale slug. Pass to search_products.sale_slug to filter to products in this sale.

product_count.description: Distinct products in this sale, in the requested region.

min_discount.description: Lowest discount percent across the sale.

max_discount.description: Highest discount percent across the sale.

ends_at.description: The latest end time across every purchasable product in the sale, as Unix seconds. Null when every purchasable product in the sale is open-ended. Individual products can end sooner - an out-of-stock or unpriced product does not extend this value. Read valid_until on each product for that product's own deadline.

items.description: Every aggregate on this record - product_count, min_discount, max_discount, ends_at - is computed over the products a customer can buy right now, under the same availability, stock, price, and release-date defaults search_products applies. A sale where every product currently fails those defaults produces no row at all rather than one with product_count 0.

Present only when count is at least 5 and the facet has a landing page. tags -> /en/categories/<slug>, publishers -> /en/publishers/<slug>, franchises -> /en/franchises/<slug>. developers have no landing page and never carry a url.

tools.name: get_docs
tools.title: Get documentation
tools.description: Read the Fanatical documentation: how to use this server, and the response shape of every tool. This tool is optional. The inputSchema and outputSchema of each tool describe every field. Call get_docs only when those schemas do not tell you what you need. It gives the product record field by field, bundle and pick-and-mix semantics, currency folding, date and price formats, and the rules for errors and empty results. It returns approximately 28,000 characters of markdown. Same content as https://www.fanatical.com/for-ai and https://www.fanatical.com/for-ai/tools
